old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a clear glass bottle filled with a liquid, likely water or a similar transparent substance. Inside the bottle, a white, crystalline structure is forming, resembling ice or frost. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the bottle's contents. As the video progresses, the formation of the crystals becomes more pronounced, growing taller and denser. The background features a dark setting with soft, out-of-focus lights, possibly from string lights, adding a subtle glow to the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of slow, methodical change, highlighting the natural process of crystal formation within the liquid.

caption: The video captures a close-up of a clear glass jar of transparent liquid, where a vertical string at the center is already sheathed in a column of white, jagged crystals. Crystallization continues throughout the excerpt rather than starting or finishing within view. The spiky teeth along the column's edges, especially on the right and lower half, grow slightly more pronounced. A thin bed of loose granular crystals on the jar floor accumulates a few additional grains. A small detached flake to the left stays nearly stationary beside the column, while the foam line at the surface persists with only minor bubble rearrangement. Out-of-focus white fairy lights on twisted wire frame the dark background at left and right.
